name: @sciflow/desktop
description: SciFlow 桌面端（Electron 封装：内嵌 NestJS 后端 + 本地 SQLite，离线可用）
author: SciFlow Contributors

scripts.dist: pnpm build:main && pnpm prepare:resources && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm build:main && pnpm prepare:resources && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build:main && pnpm prepare:resources && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm build:main && pnpm prepare:resources && electron-builder --linux --publish never
